_comment: The artist's own capture rig, as STATED BY HIM. Stock and reference plates (reporter_test) carry their own camera block in shot.json and must never inherit these values. Everything under `derived` is COMPUTED by scripts/capture_profile.py from the stated facts plus the delivery frame -- do not hand-edit it, and do not retype a factor of 1.6 anywhere: regenerate instead.

stated_facts._comment: Given by the artist on 2026-09-08. Nothing here is inferred.
stated_facts.camera_body: Panasonic LUMIX S5 IIX, full frame
stated_facts.external_recorder_note: None. ProRes RAW over HDMI is therefore NOT available, which is what makes the two modes below the complete set of options.

recording_mode.status: NOT YET CHOSEN by the artist.
recording_mode.why_it_is_still_open: Open gate 3:2 is Long GOP / MOV only on this body, so the mode with the best geometry has the worst codec for keying, and the mode with the best codec costs 20.6% of the frame. There is no option that wins both.
recording_mode.consequence_for_the_pipeline: Every stage must read the mode from the shot rather than assuming one. scripts/capture_profile.py exists for exactly this: a shot names a profile and the stage asks what ingest steps that profile requires.

open_gate_6k.label: 6K 3:2 open gate, HEVC 10-bit 4:2:0 Long GOP 200 Mbps
open_gate_6k.trade: Perfect geometry and the most resolution headroom, worst codec for keying. Long GOP is the only option in this mode on this body, so the all-intra transcode is mandatory rather than advisable, and 4:2:0 means chroma is quartered in area on a plate whose key is a chroma operation.

c58k_17_9.label: 5.8K 17:9, ProRes 422 HQ 1.6 Gbps all-intra, LPCM
c58k_17_9.trade: Best codec for keying: all-intra removes the Long GOP mosquito noise that makes a matte crawl, 4:2:2 keeps full vertical chroma resolution, and the bitrate is 8x. Costs 20.6% of the frame width and narrows the 35 mm to roughly a 44 mm equivalent. 1.91x is still comfortable supersampling for the matte.

recording_mode.recommendation: c58k_17_9, on keying grounds. All-intra and 4:2:2 remove two of the three ingest hazards outright, and the resolution headroom given up existed mainly to fight the compression artefacts that the better codec does not produce. This is a recommendation, not a decision.

derived._comment: Computed by scripts/capture_profile.py for a 3840x1600 delivery at 1.6x squeeze and a 35 mm taking lens. There are deliberately NO mode-independent field-of-view numbers here: field of view depends on which mode is chosen, and an earlier version of this file carried a single stale vertical FOV that was simply wrong.
derived.render_focal_note: Rendering the DESQUEEZED frame with a spherical camera at this focal length on a 36 mm horizontal sensor reproduces both the horizontal and the vertical field of view exactly. See scripts/anamorphic.py.

pipeline_implications.anamorphic: The recorded plate is horizontally squeezed 1.6x and Blender renders spherically, so plate and CG do not share a projection until a shot records which space it works in. Depth and normal estimators are trained on spherical imagery: run them on the DESQUEEZED plate or a face is 1.6x too narrow and the estimated geometry is plausible and wrong. A silent 1.6x error here is invisible in a single frame.
pipeline_implications.defocus: Anamorphic bokeh is a vertical oval, not a circle, and the depth of field is that of the 35 mm taking lens rather than the 21.875 mm equivalent that sets the field of view. scripts/anamorphic.py carries both; aperture_ratio 1.6 was MEASURED to give a 1.6:1 vertical oval, not assumed.
pipeline_implications.motion_blur: 180 degrees at 24 fps is 1/48 s. Set Blender motion blur shutter to 0.5 explicitly rather than inheriting the default, which happens to be the same value.
pipeline_implications.white_balance: Daylight-balanced at 5600 K. An environment lit warmer or cooler will not match the plate's rendering of skin unless the relight ratio carries the difference. Do not neutralise the plate to grey and then relight, or the correction is applied twice.
pipeline_implications.flares: Anamorphic flares and streaks are horizontal and typically blue. If practicals are in frame, matching this is part of the photorealism bar, not a stylistic extra.
pipeline_implications.colour: V-Log over V-Gamut must be decoded to scene-linear Rec.709 ON INGEST, before keying. Every stage downstream assumes that working space: keyer thresholds, depth and normal estimators, the SH irradiance ratio, the PQ grade. Undecoded, all of them are wrong while still producing a picture. NOT IMPLEMENTED YET and the constants are NOT VERIFIED: check them against Panasonic documentation and a shot ColorChecker before trusting any measurement taken from his footage. Never apply a creative display LUT first -- it is not invertible and discards the highlight range the HDR grade exists for.
pipeline_implications.keying: MODE-DEPENDENT: see recording_mode.candidates[].ingest_steps_required rather than assuming. Both candidate modes are subsampled, so chroma must be upsampled before keying -- a green-screen key is a chroma operation. Only the open-gate mode is Long GOP and therefore only that mode needs the all-intra transcode, without which mosquito noise around the silhouette and every hair makes the matte crawl. Both modes oversample the delivery frame, so key at native resolution and downscale afterwards: the matte comes out effectively supersampled and hair edges get real fractional alpha instead of a hard decision. Keying thresholds never transfer between plates in either direction; run scripts/calibrate_key.py per shot.

still_to_record: CHOOSE THE RECORDING MODE. Until then the pipeline must support both.
A ColorChecker and an 18% grey card at the head of a take, to verify the V-Log/V-Gamut decode rather than inheriting its constants.
A chrome ball and an 18% grey ball on a slate at the head of every take, which converts E_source from the pipeline's weakest assumption into a measurement.
The artist's own interocular distance, measured once with a ruler, to remove the 63 mm adult prior from every camera solve.

The exact open-gate active sensor area, if a precise camera solve ever depends on it. The nominal 36 x 24 mm is used throughout; the 3:2 aspect that the anamorphic arithmetic depends on is exact either way.
